notes: Random 40 x 40 cell map of groups 0..2; groups 0, 1, 2 and 0xff; points inside, on and outside the map (negative, beyond 400, Y with a zero low word). The group test 0xcc1ac is a stub that logs AL, DL and EBX and answers a pseudo-random bit from a call counter and the cell byte, so the call order is checked too.
